description: This file defines the CompatibilityDirectorManager class which manages different compatibility strategies and directors within the Orleans runtime, allowing for configuration and retrieval of version compatibility logic for grain interfaces.

classes.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
classes.description: Manages compatibility strategies and directors, providing methods to get and set strategies for grain interface types.

methods.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the compatibility director manager with service provider and options.

methods.name: GetDirector
methods.description: Returns an ICompatibilityDirector for a given GrainInterfaceType, or the default if not explicitly set.

methods.name: SetStrategy
methods.description: Sets a specific compatibility strategy for a given GrainInterfaceType.
